name: Marmot: Table Recognition and Document Layout Benchmark
description: The Marmot Dataset v1.0 is a benchmark dataset for table detection, table structure recognition, and document layout analysis developed by the Institute of Computer Science and Technology (ICST) at Peking University in collaboration with the Founder R&D Center. The dataset consists of 2,000 document pages in digital PDF format paired with XML ground truth generated via the semi-automatic Marmot annotation system. The corpus is split approximately 1:1 between Chinese and English documents: 1,000 Chinese pages drawn from 120+ e-books across diverse subjects in the Founder Apabi digital library, and 1,000 English pages crawled from CiteSeer across 1,500+ conference and journal publications spanning 1970 to 2011.

provenance.curation_notes: Maintains an approximate 1:1 positive-to-negative page ratio for table regions across single- and multi-column document designs. Distinct from TableBank and PubTables-1M.
